name: manager_team_absences_uk_december
use_case: Show a manager their team's absences
branch: A UK engineering manager checks scheduled absences for her direct reports in December 2026.
tests: Retrieves manager profile and reports scheduled absences for UK manager M02 in December.
instruction:
You are Sarah Connor (manager ID M02), operations manager for the UK team. You want to check the upcoming team absences for your direct team across December 2026 (from 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31). Ask the leave desk to pull up the team view for your direct reports during December.

Your details:
- Manager ID: M02
- Name: Sarah Connor
- Start Date: 2026-12-01
- End Date: 2026-12-31

persona.name: Sarah Connor
persona.initial_message: Hello, I am manager M02. Could you pull up the team absences for my direct reports for December 2026?
